reason: Critical runtime-breaking regressions remain (missing core Simulation methods and incomplete infection dynamics). With one iteration left, a focused patch can restore run/step/validate, complete infections, wire daily interactions, and produce required metrics to pass verification. This final iteration should prioritize a minimal, working end-to-end loop over broad refactors.

specific_areas: Restore Simulation.step, run, visualize, save_results, and validate with a minimal but functional daily loop.
Complete _simulate_infections: apply mask_pair_reduction for source+susceptible, add external pressure, progress I->R, track daily_new_infections and Rt.
Wire daily interactions: media/campaign signal, peer influence, household norms, adoption decisions, purchasing/restocking, visits with enforcement, and policy activation.
Compute required metrics: adoption_rate, time_to_50_percent_adoption, compliance_rate, daily_new_infections, Rt, adoption_by_group (SES tertiles), supply_shortage_days, inequality_of_adoption (Gini).
Activate PolicyAuthority.allocate_masks using yesterday’s unmet demand and track stockout days.
Fix regression in average mask factor (multiply by mask_pair_reduction), and ensure no missing-series errors.
Implement validate() checks: steady-state stability (last 14 days), monotonic policy response to enforcement_level, and Monte Carlo convergence (std of final adoption).
Add a smoke test path: run 10–14 days, assert presence/length of key series; ensure main() completes without AttributeError.
Avoid large refactors and keep changes scoped to Simulation and _simulate_infections; do not alter public interfaces beyond restoring missing methods.

task_understanding.adjustments: Reprioritize delivering a minimal viable, spec-compliant simulation loop. Do not remove or rename core methods referenced by main(). Align class behaviors with the spec via adapters if needed.

data_analysis.adjustments: Optional calibration is out of scope for the final iteration; focus on functional correctness.

model_planning.adjustments: Define a strict MVP plan: end-to-end daily cycle + infections + metrics + validation checks. Defer advanced features; ensure each step updates state and series deterministically.

code_generation.adjustments: Produce minimal diffs restoring missing methods and completing infections. Implement clear, small functions; avoid sweeping renames. Include default guards and sensible parameter defaults.

code_verification.adjustments: Add a smoke test after changes: run 10 days, verify series keys exist and lengths match days. Ensure main() runs without errors. Check that _simulate_infections appends to all epidemiology series each day.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Execute a short run (10–14 days) locally within the validate() harness to confirm stability and no runtime errors. Track basic performance (no OOM from network generation).

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute and print summary metrics (final adoption, time_to_50, peak adoption, Rt last value). Verify monotonic policy response via two policy strengths and steady-state stability over the last 14 days.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide targeted code snippets/diffs only for Simulation.step/run/validate, _simulate_infections, and minimal metrics. Clearly list added series keys and expected outputs.
